s: Save AEMP 2.0 telematics data and link new equipment to a telematics provider
d: Posts ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) telematics data and, for machines that are not linked yet, creates the Procore equipment record and links it to your telematics provider account using OEMName and EquipmentID or SerialNumber. Use the v2.0 endpoint when the equipment is already linked.

Posts telematics diagnostics for a piece of Procore equipment. Identify the equipment with resource_id, or with oem_id and oem_name when the equipment is already linked to a telematics provider. Use the canonical keys, names, and units as per example. Diagnostics with other keys…

s: Save AEMP 2.0 telematics data for equipment already linked to a telematics provider
d: Posts ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) telematics data for equipment that is already linked to your telematics provider account. Procore matches each machine to its Procore equipment record using OEMName together with EquipmentID, or SerialNumber when EquipmentID is absent. Use the v2.1 e…
Returns the canonical diagnostic keys, display names, value types, and units of measure supported for equipment telematics. Currently only the EQUIPMENT target type is supported.
